story.radio.day1: Houston: Welcome to the Moon! We fly home on Day 7.
story.radio.day1.hs: Houston: We hear you! Your lander is lost. Fix the base ship. Home by seven.
story.radio.quiet: Scout: All quiet today. Great day to explore!
story.radio.quiet.hs: Scout: Quiet Sun today. Good day for rover runs!
story.radio.watch: Houston: The Sun just flared. A storm may come.
story.radio.alert: Houston: Flare alert! I don't know how strong yet.
story.radio.storm: Scout: Radiation is up! My dosimeter clicks fast.
story.radio.emergency: Pilot: Backup tank on. Today the base runs itself.
story.radio.emergency.hs: Houston: Backup tank on. I run the base today. You rest.
story.radio.family: Zuhra: Hi from home! Buvi and I wave every night.
story.radio.family.hs: Buvi: Salom from Tashkent! Is your doʻppi with you?
story.radio.launchDay: Pilot: Launch day! Charge the lander and fly home.
story.radio.launchDay.hs: Houston: Launch day! Charge the ship and fly home.
story.card.dust.text: Dust covers the solar wing! Brush now, or lose power every day.
story.card.dust.text.hs: Crash dust covers the solar panel! Brush now, or lose power every day.
story.card.filter.text: The water filter is clogged! Swap it now, or lose water every day.
story.card.filter.text.hs: The Air Maker's water filter is clogged! Swap it now, or lose air every day.
story.card.shadow.text: A ridge shadow will chill the garden tonight.
story.card.shadow.text.hs: A ridge shadow will chill the Greenhouse tonight.
story.card.ice.text: Ice signal in a dark crater! Long walk, bonus find.
story.card.ice.text.hs: Signal in the dark crater: your antenna! Long drive, big part.
story.card.request.text: Scientists need extra samples by tomorrow. Explore more today and tomorrow for a bonus.
story.card.request.text.hs: Houston needs the engine valve by tomorrow. Extra rover runs today and tomorrow: bonus part.
story.card.tired.text: The crew slept badly. Rest: less exploring. Push on: more tired.
story.card.tired.text.hs: You slept badly. Rest: fewer rover runs. Push on: more tired.
story.card.sunrise.text: The Sun rose early over the ridge! Extra power today.
story.houston.alert: I don't know its strength yet. Inside is safer. Outside finds more.
story.houston.alert.hs: I don't know its strength yet. Inside is safer. Rover runs bring more parts.
story.houston.storm: Everyone inside blocks the most. A wall helps too.
story.houston.storm.hs: Staying inside blocks the most. A wall helps too.
story.radio.callCut: Houston: Call cut! A flare on the Sun.
story.radio.callCut.hs: Houston: Call cut! A flare on the Sun. I don't know its strength yet.
story.radio.workshop: Pilot: Workshop open! A wall level costs two.
story.radio.workshop.hs: Houston: Workshop open! A shield wall costs two.
story.radio.harvest: Pilot: The seeds sprouted in Moon soil!
story.radio.harvest.hs: Scout: Harvest tonight! Food for the flight home.
